bibl.title: A Local Will with a “Codicillary” Clause
bibl.seg: Maria Nowak & W. Graham Claytor, A Local Will with a "Codicillary" Clause.
Pylon. Editions and Studies of Ancient Texts 4 (2023) §1-29, figg.
bibl.note: P. Mich. Inv. 6215i recto. Oxyrhynchos(?), ca. 150-200 CE. - The "codicillary" clause (ll. 8-9) allows the testator to make changes to the ekdosimon, or official copy, of their will.
